description: This file defines the 'DisabledModuleController' class within the OrangeHRM project, specifically in the Common Controllers namespace. It extends an abstract Vue controller and overrides the preRender method to set a disabled-module component, indicating its role in handling UI logic related to disabled modules.

classes.name: DisabledModuleController
classes.description: Controller for handling disabled modules in the UI, extends AbstractVueController and sets a specific Vue component during pre-render phase.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Overrides the preRender method from the parent class to instantiate and set the 'disabled-module' Vue component.
